input.content: Retry freezes first-attempt payload (service.py save): the contract says a failed save may be retried with the same ID and edited values, and that success means the latest values are active. The recovery update stored values only when the record was created and skipped apply once status was "applied" (receipt failed after apply). A retry with edited values therefore returned ok while the stale values stayed active. Because the provider apply is idempotent, re-apply the latest values on every non-completed retry instead of gating on intermediate status.
